title: CH62026: Fluidization Engineering
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite - CH20001 or equivalentHistorical background, Important
applications such as transportation, mixing of particulates, coating, particle
growth, adsorption, clinkerisation, roasting, synthesis reactions, cracking of
hydrocarbons, carbonization, combustion, gasification etc. Merits and demerits
of the system. Liquid-like properties of fluidized system. Gross behavior of
fluidized bed systems. Mono and poly dispersed particles and their
characteristics. Terminal setting velocity and its interaction with fluid
velocity. Text Book:1.Fluidization by Max Leva2.Fluidization engineering by D.
Kunni and o. Levenspiel3.Fluidization by J. F. Davidson, R. Cliff and D.
Harrison
